articles.body: The National Republican Senatorial Committee is shifting its focus away from the North Carolina and Georgia Senate races as it works to shore up red states like Texas and flip other Democratic-held seats. In a closed-door meeting Wednesday, Sen. Tim Scott, the chair of the NRSC, told Senate Republicans that the campaign arm will focus its spending going forward on defending GOP seats in Maine, Alaska, Ohio, Iowa and Texas and trying to flip the Democratic-held seats of Michigan and New Hampshire, according to four people in the room who were granted anonymity to share private details. That list notably leaves out North Carolina GOP nominee Michael Whatley’s battle against Democrat Roy Cooper and Georgia GOP nominee Mike Collins’ effort to unseat Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff . Scott’s briefing is the clearest sign yet that Republicans have deprioritized the two states, as POLITICO has reported , while senior Republicans grow increasingly resigned to the possibility of losing those races. It’s a remarkable shift: President Donald Trump carried Georgia twice in 2016 and 2024 and North Carolina over the last three presidential elections. In deprioritizing North Carolina, the NRSC is effectively ceding a state that Democrats haven’t won in the Senate since 2008. Still, other GOP groups with massive war chests, including Trump’s MAGA Inc., could pick up the slack. Scott also shared with the senators polling showing Republicans are locked in tight battles in several other key races, which tracks with much of the public polling, according to the four people. For example, one poll found that GOP Sen. Jon Husted of Ohio is still trailing former Democratic Sen. Sherrod Brown. Scott also showed polling indicating Republican John Sununu is essentially neck-and-neck with Democratic Rep. Chris Pappas in New Hampshire, a seat Republicans are laser-focused on trying to flip. The NRSC didn't initially respond to a request for comment. In a statement provided after publication, NRSC Communications Director Joanna Rodriguez said: “This completely fabricated story should be retracted and Politico should be embarrassed. Chairman Scott didn’t make any spending announcements at lunch and he praised Michael Whatley as an example of a candidate who has polling momentum on his side.” “As Roy Cooper said earlier this year about U.S. Senate races in North Carolina, 'Democrats are often ahead until they are not.' And then just last week Cooper, correctly, observed, 'We know a lot of undecided voters lean Republican.' We’re confident we will have the resources to get our message out to North Carolina voters and win,” said Whatley Spokesman DJ Griffin in a statement. Collins' campaign did not respond to a request for comment. Georgia GOP party chair Josh McKoon dismissed the notion that his state was being deprioritized by Republicans in Washington, even as he acknowledged beating Ossoff will be a challenge. “Every cycle, someone in Washington leaks that they’re thinking about moving money,” he said in a text message. “What matters is who shows up — and what the actual numbers say.” Senate Majority Leader John Thune is set to headline a fundraiser for Collins in Atlanta on Thursday, alongside the state’s popular Republican governor, Brian Kemp. The Collins campaign is also making the case that one in 10 Georgia voters — who backed Trump in 2024 and plan to vote for Jackson — are still "up for grabs,” according to a memo obtained by POLITICO . “The goal in Georgia is to strike a balance where you are spending as little for Senate as possible while not derailing Rick Jackson’s, so far, very strong bid for Governor in a difficult environment,” said a GOP pollster granted anonymity to speak candidly about the landscape. Public polling shows the governor’s race has much tighter margins, with Jackson leading Democratic nominee Keisha Lance Bottoms in some recent surveys . Sen. John Cornyn (R-Texas), who lost his Senate primary to Trump-backed Ken Paxton, was also in the room. He later told POLITICO that the party has to make tough decisions. “At some point I think the people spending that money are going to have to make hard choices and figure out where the money can have the biggest impact, and certainly Texas is the most expensive,” Cornyn said.
articles.headline: NRSC Chair Tim Scott leaves Georgia, North Carolina off his list of top Senate targets

articles.body: Q THE LANDSLIDE: Quinnipiac University released a poll today that found Gov. Kathy Hochul leading Republican Bruce Blakeman 58-39 — putting her on track for the fourth-largest landslide by a New York gubernatorial candidate in the past 200 years. It’s by far the best poll for Hochul this year and certainly better than a Siena University survey out this morning that found her with a modest 9 point lead over the Nassau County executive. So which one’s closer to reality? The last time both pollsters released New York numbers on the same day was a few weeks before Hochul’s last election in 2022. Siena found at the time that her lead over then-Rep. Lee Zeldin was quickly shrinking, having dropped from 17 to 11 points. The Q Poll painted a more dire picture for the governor. “We released a poll in mid-October showing that Hochul had a 4 point lead over Lee Zeldin,” Quinnipiac spokesperson Mary Snow said. “And it went against the grain of other polls out there at the time.” Hochul wound up winning that race by about 6 points. Pollster vs. pollster results in prior elections have been mixed. Both Q and Siena nailed Andrew Cuomo’s eventual 23 point margin of victory in October 2018 polls, though Siena’s early November numbers that year found Cuomo’s lead had shrunk to 13. An infamous Q Poll from September 2010 found Cuomo with a stunningly small 6 point lead over Buffalo firebrand Carl Paladino, while a Siena poll the next day found a much more predictive 57-24 Cuomo advantage. The biggest difference this time around is that Quinnipiac assumed a higher share of November’s turnout will be in deep blue New York City. The five boroughs accounted for 31 percent of the statewide turnout in 2022 and 34 percent in 2018. Siena’s sample assumed 30 percent of this year’s voters will come from there, while 38 percent of Quinnipiac’s sample was from the city. Quinnipiac also does more to avoid undecided voters. “One tweak that we made after 2020 was an adjustment to the questions that we ask, so that we try to cut down on the number of people who say they don’t know,” Snow said. Only 3 percent of the Q Poll’s sample declined to weigh in on the Hochul-Blakeman race, while the comparable number was 9 percent in Siena’s poll. And it appears as if a lot of the Quinnipiac respondents who might not have answered Siena’s questions broke toward the incumbent: Siena has Hochul winning New York City 61-27 while Quinnipiac has her up 70-27; Siena had her up 57-34 among women while Quinnipiac found her lead at 63-34. Another notable difference between the methodologies that may account for the divergent results is that Quinnipiac’s sample was based on asking respondents what party they affiliate with. Siena uses voter registration files. “For a couple of years running, the New York Times/Siena Poll was ranked as the most accurate poll in America,” Siena spokesperson Steve Greenberg said. “Siena has been polling New York state for nearly a quarter of a century, and we have shown that we get it right almost all of the time.” Republicans, for their part, believe both sets of numbers are far overstating Hochul’s advantage. “Blakeman is closer in the polls I’ve seen than Lee Zeldin was at this moment in time four years ago,” state Senate Republican Campaign Committee Chair George Borrello said. “As I travel around New York state, I have seen literally thousands of Bruce Blakeman signs. Yet I can count on one hand the number of Kathy Hochul signs I’ve seen, unless you count the ones that say ‘Fire Hochul.’” — Bill Mahoney From the Capitol MEGAWATT DEAL: New York has made its first awards for large-scale batteries under a new program and secured contracts for new renewables that are close to getting built. The state’s energy authority contracted for 719 megawatts from 13 solar, wind and hydroelectric projects and 950 megawatts of battery storage from eight projects. NYSERDA President and CEO Doreen Harris announced the awards Wednesday during a Climate Week event hosted by the state’s renewable developers association. “Everything that we do with respect to our energy system costs money,” Harris said. “When we invest in clean energy, not only are we talking about low single-digit percentage increases in cost, we are talking about benefits that far exceed those costs.” Hochul warned that federal headwinds and rising expenses made a more ambitious pace of transitioning to clean energy too costly as she successfully fought to weaken New York’s ambitious climate law earlier this year. But she has highlighted her continued support for progress on offshore wind, renewables, storage and nuclear this week. New York and developers are racing the expiration of federal tax credits. Renewables that didn’t start construction by July 4 — or don’t finish work by the end of the year if they start after that deadline — won’t be eligible for those key incentives that lower the cost of contracts for the state. Read more from POLITICO Pro’s Marie J. French here. FROM CITY HALL MAKING ROOM: Bellevue Hospital announced a major renovation and expansion of its inpatient psychiatric wing, fueled by an infusion of $25.6 million from the City Council. Bellevue, which is part of the NYC Health + Hospitals system, will use the new capital funding to add 40 beds for adult psychiatric patients over the next few years — bringing the division’s total capacity to 204 beds. Hospital officials said the expansion will ease the bottleneck of patients with severe mental illnesses who need to be admitted for continued observation and treatment; those inpatient psychiatric units have been operating consistently at 98% capacity. “The need here demanded an investment of this scale,” Council member Virginia Maloney, who spearheaded the funding, said during a news conference in the hospital’s atrium. Bellevue Hospital CEO Eric Wei said the facility has seen a bump in psychiatric patients since the April 2025 closure of Mount Sinai Beth Israel several blocks away. Bellevue’s dedicated ER for psychiatric patients, which Wei said sees about 30 patients daily, is undergoing its own $40 million expansion. “We are unfortunately needing to transfer out about 90 patients a month to other inpatient units because there’s no room in our inpatient psychiatric units,” Wei said in an interview. “We’re always feeling like I’m toeing the line. We’re very busy.” Bellevue was so overwhelmed as of late that hospital officials asked FDNY to stop bringing them patients with psychiatric emergencies, according to EMS union Local 2507. Those diversion requests continued for at least a couple weeks in late August and early September, a union spokesperson said. — Maya Kaufman IN OTHER NEWS — INSTITUTIONAL FAILURE: A NYC high school which once enrolled 3,000 students now has only 90. ( The City Reporter )   — FIRST IN THE NATION: In a new TV ad, Hochul is touting her first-in-the-nation data center moratorium. ( City & State )   — HITTING THE BRAKES: The rollout of electric school buses in New York state has been rocky. ( The New York Times ) Missed this morning’s New York Playbook? We forgive you. articles.body: A small group of White House officials is exploring whether to cut back President Donald Trump’s decision to increase foreign beef imports, as GOP panic rises ahead of the midterms. The proposal to reduce the amount of imports is being discussed within the Domestic Policy Council headed by Vince Haley, a longtime Trump speechwriter and former campaign official, and a few other officials at the White House, according to two people with direct knowledge of the conversations, who were granted anonymity to share private details. Trump officials are unsure if anything will come of the talks. The two people said the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative disagrees with cutting back the imports, since it aims to lower high consumer beef prices in the short term and since USTR helped implement the move. But their conversations about partly rolling back the beef policy — which Trump instituted in August — is a clear sign the White House is trying to stem the alarm from battleground and farm-state Republicans as high prices and Trump’s tariffs roil their election campaigns. The White House is also preparing a plan on diesel exports, likely with exemptions, amid sky-high prices from the Iran war. The White House and USTR, in statements after this article published, denied that there was any official action on the table. “There’s no pending policy change to ‘disagree’ with," a USTR official said. “The administration is focused on the interest of American ranchers and consumers. All agencies are supporting the President in these goals." “The White House is not considering such action. As the President directed in his executive order, the USDA and USTR continue to monitor beef imports to ensure that savings are being passed onto consumers,” White House spokesperson Kush Desai said. Earlier this week, Iowa Rep. Ashley Hinson, the GOP Senate nominee, took the extraordinary step of publicly breaking with Trump, saying gas prices were too high because of the Iran war and that farmers in her state are suffering. Michigan Senate GOP nominee Mike Rogers and other vulnerable House and Senate Republicans have made similar breaks. Farm-state lawmakers in Iowa and beyond have publicly called for the White House to provide some relief from the beef import executive action in particular, because of its impact on farmers and ranchers. Sen. Chuck Grassley, the rest of the Iowa delegation and other senior farm-state lawmakers have all pressed the administration to change course — to no avail. Trump did sign an executive order of rancher-friendly policies as a way to address the initial backlash. But U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer made clear to a group of House Republicans in a closed-door briefing earlier this month that Trump’s executive action to import 300,000 metric tons of beef without certain tariffs and at discounted prices would go forward as planned, as POLITICO first reported.
articles.headline: Trump officials weigh rolling back beef import plan as GOP midterm panic spreads

articles.body: The cryptocurrency industry is at a political crossroads. Reeling from the demise of its longtime top legislative priority, crypto companies must now decide how scorched-earth to go against Senate Democrats, who last week voted unanimously against the so-called Clarity Act, a sweeping bill that would create a bespoke new regulatory framework for digital assets. A crypto-backed PAC network’s move this week provides a hint of what may be to come. The group, known as Fairshake, announced it would spend at least $30 million to help block Democrat Sherrod Brown from recapturing a pivotal Ohio Senate seat, representing the first major signal of how the industry plans to deploy its massive campaign war chest in the final weeks before the 2026 midterms. Some crypto executives have publicly signaled an appetite in recent days for punishing Democrats. But a partisan strategy carries major political risk for the industry: A broad offensive against Democrats ahead of an election where they have a chance to reclaim power on Capitol Hill could further alienate lawmakers the industry may soon need to revive its agenda. “As much as some people may want to, they can’t wave a wand and make Democrats go away,” said Sheila Warren, the former CEO of the Crypto Council for Innovation, an industry trade group. “Every industry — not just crypto — has to figure out what to do with that reality.” The crypto industry’s spending could have immediate consequences after the election. Democrats are signaling that a Senate GOP-aligned spending spree would suppress any appetite for lame duck dealmaking involving the Clarity bill — although it remains a long shot that it would come back to life regardless. A Senate Democratic aide involved in the crypto effort said a full-scale assault on the party’s Senate candidates “would absolutely eviscerate any hope” of a post-election deal. The Fairshake PAC group, funded primarily by crypto firms Coinbase and Ripple and venture capital giant Andreessen Horowitz, had more than $120 million at its disposal as of the end of August. It has previously deployed its war chest to help members of both parties who support industry-friendly policies. Fairshake is preparing to announce additional spending decisions supporting both Democrats and Republicans in the coming days, according to a spokesperson for the group, Geoff Vetter. But it’s unclear what races — or which chamber — it will target next. Kara Calvert, Coinbase’s vice president of U.S. policy, said in an interview that bipartisanship has been crypto’s “superpower.” “Nobody is eager to erode that,” she said. Though Fairshake says it will maintain a bipartisan approach, it hasn’t specified what shape that will take. One potential avenue for the PAC is to continue to back crypto-friendly Democrats running for the House — where the Clarity bill advanced with 78 Democratic votes last year — but primarily help Republicans in the Senate. Fairshake spent in favor of several Senate Democrats in the 2024 elections, including in battleground general election races in Michigan and Arizona, where it backed Democratic Sens. Elissa Slotkin and Ruben Gallego, respectively. It also plowed more than $40 million into the effort to help defeat Brown in his 2024 reelection campaign — by far its biggest spend of the cycle. This time, Republicans are pressing the industry to recalibrate its approach and ditch the Democrats. “To reward people who voted against the motion to proceed on Clarity after the Democrats got 126 amendments in the bill would be a huge mistake,” said Sen. Cynthia Lummis, the crypto bill’s leading champion in the Senate. The Wyoming Republican is retiring when her term ends in January. Democrats, who feel increasingly confident about their chances in November despite the GOP’s spending advantages, say Republicans are trying to play the crypto industry. It’s “been the goal of Republican colleagues all along to try to get folks to invest in races, versus them trying to get a piece of legislation done, and someone needs to call the Republicans out on their bullshit,” said Sen. Ben Ray Luján (D-N.M.), who added: “Sherrod’s gonna win.”
articles.headline: Crypto weighs revenge against Democrats — and the risks that come with it

articles.body: LOCAL INPUT: Mayor Zohran Mamdani is facing fresh backlash over sidelining key stakeholders from talks about developing thousands of housing units on top of a Queens rail yard. The Sunnyside Yard project landed back in the headlines yesterday when Mamdani and President Donald Trump emerged from a chummy meeting at Gracie Mansion to announce they’d agreed to bring conversations about the long-stalled housing plan to “a new level.” The unlikely duo first announced at a White House meeting in February they were looking into reviving the project, which would be contingent on billions of dollars in federal funding and involve constructing a platform over the rail yard, on top of which 12,000 housing units would be built. But Council member Julie Won — who represents Sunnyside and voiced concerns in February about not being included in the talks — said today she continues to be troubled by the fact that the mayor and the president aren’t consulting her or other local community voices. “Since the last discussion on Sunnyside Yard months ago between the mayor and president there is no funding from Congress nor any public meetings to move this project forward,” Won said in a statement. “There is no federal, state, or city bill allocating funding for this project. There is still no timeline. Congress would have to fund it, and the State and City Legislature would have to approve it. Our neighbors in Sunnyside yet again were not part of yesterday's conversation, and there still has been no meaningful engagement with the public.” Farah Salam, Won’s chief of staff, said City Hall’s continued lack of engagement with her office flies in the face of a commitment Mamdani’s team made in February. Salam recounted how, in a meeting with Won’s team at the time, Mamdani aides told the Council member’s staff they would keep them in the loop on any Sunnyside Yard-related updates. Nonetheless, Salam told Playbook that Won and her team haven’t heard a peep from Mamdani’s administration since then, and she added that Won only learned of the latest twist from watching Mamdani’s post-meeting press conference with Trump yesterday. A Mamdani spokesperson declined to respond to Salam’s comments. Won is a member of the Council’s Progressive Caucus, which has generally been supportive of the mayor, lending more weight to her Sunnyside-related rebuke. Still, she may have some political sour grapes with the mayor, given that she campaigned unsuccessfully this summer for Congress in a race that was ultimately won by Mamdani-endorsed Assemblymember Claire Valdez. Won isn’t the only local politician concerned by Mamdani’s Sunnyside dealings with Trump, though. Queens Borough President Donovan Richards told Playbook it would be more fruitful for Mamdani to focus on securing federal funding from Trump for housing developments where shovels can hit the ground on a short timeframe. Inevitably, Sunnyside Yard would need to go through years-long review and permitting processes before construction could begin, and Richards argued Jamaica and Long Island City are better suited for immediate, federally-backed projects, given that both areas recently underwent neighborhood-wide rezonings. “I’m not saying give up on Sunnyside Yard, but let’s first move somewhere where we can actually get shovels in the ground now,” he said. “We are in a housing emergency.” Richards also said he’s skeptical Trump will actually make good on his Sunnyside musings. “I have trepidations about how fast the Trump administration is going to move on this — forgive me if I have my trepidations about them,” he said. “Anything you deal with the Trump administration on has to be show and tell, and I don’t have much confidence even with the president's remarks yesterday.” When asked about the comments from Won and Richards at a press conference today, Mamdani avoided any direct response. Instead he simply reiterated the merits of the project, which he said would include a significant share of affordable housing. “I will do everything in my power to build more housing in this city,” Mamdani said. “And working with the president to fulfill an idea that has existed for 50 to 60 years — that to me is clearly an example of what could be done.” It remains to be seen how much Trump and Mamdani can actually get done on the Sunnyside project. Though they said yesterday their respective housing policy teams are initiating technical talks about the project, there are no funding commitments on the table, and local community concerns remain. Former Mayor Bill de Blasio announced a plan in 2015 to build housing on top of Sunnyside Yard, but that iteration of the project never went anywhere because of the COVID pandemic and local pushback. — Chris Sommerfeldt and Joe Anuta  From the Capitol IT GUY GONE: The top official at the state’s Office of Information Technology Services was removed this week by Gov. Kathy Hochul after she lost confidence in him, her administration said today. ITS Director Dru Rai held the job since September 2023, and his removal was effective immediately. Jenson Jacob will take over the role in an acting capacity. The office manages the state's information technology, data centers and hardware infrastructure while providing digital services for state agencies and local governments. “The administration has informed Dru Rai that the Governor no longer has confidence in his ability to effectively represent this administration and he was removed from his position as head of ITS," a Hochul spokesperson said in a statement. "Jenson Jacob has been named Acting Director of ITS. Governor Hochul remains committed to holding employees to the highest leadership and ethical standards, and ITS will continue to deliver technology solutions and services for New Yorkers, our agencies and partners.” Read more from POLITICO Pro’s Nick Reisman. BLAKEMAN BRUSHES OFF GRACIE GATHERING: Republican gubernatorial candidate Bruce Blakeman is downplaying the significance of Trump’s cordial Monday meeting with the mayor. “Not at all,” he said when asked if Trump’s visit undercut Blakeman’s focus on Mamdani’s radicalism. “The president is a government official. He’s the highest government official in the United States. And the mayor’s a government official, so I expect that the two of them would talk.” Blakeman has attacked the mayor he refers to as “Commie Mamdani” while campaigning in every corner of the state. Would he similarly meet with Mamdani? “Depends what he was serving for lunch,” he said. The Nassau County executive was in Albany today to receive the NYS Correctional Officers and Police Benevolent Association’s endorsement. Prison guards have had an icy relationship with the state in recent years, due to Cuomo-era limits on solitary confinement and Hochul’s strict crackdown on guards who engaged in an illegal strike last year. It’s the first time NYSCOPBA has endorsed a gubernatorial candidate. “Kathy Hochul, I want you to think about that: 95 percent of your employees voted to endorse me, a democratic vote,” Blakeman said. “What does that say about your leadership? You should be embarrassed that 95 percent of your workers didn’t think highly enough of you to endorse you.” — Bill Mahoney FROM CITY HALL LEFT ON READ: City Council members — including the mayor’s allies — laced into Mamdani’s administration today at a Council hearing on the use of influencers in city government communications. The central focus of their displeasure? Team Mamdani declined to send any representatives from the appropriate agencies to testify. The oversight hearing comes on the heels of news that programs run by city agencies paid influencers to promote city policies. The hearing’s stated purpose: to begin to establish guidelines for how city officials communicate with influencers and disclose such communications. Emilia Rowland, the mayor’s director of new media, skipped the hearing, despite being invited to testify. Earlier this month, a working paper from the Columbia University Initiative for Policy Dialogue reported that Rowland oversees a Signal group chat with more than 200 hand-picked influencers. In her place, the mayor’s office sent Tascha Van Auken, commissioner of the mayor’s Office of Mass Engagement, and Shawn(ta) Smith-Cruz, commissioner for the Department of Records and Information Services — neither of whom had much to offer on the administration’s use of influencers. While pressing the two during their testimony, Public Advocate Jumaane Williams expressed disappointment that the communications officials who “should be here are not.” “I don't know that anything was done wrong, but there were questions that were raised by this article that I believe the public should hear answers to, so that they can feel sure that nothing wrong occurred,” Williams said. “The fact that the correct folks aren't here doesn't really help that story.” Williams, a progressive Democrat, found himself in agreement with Council Minority Leader David Carr, the Republican who sponsored legislation that would require explicit disclosures on city-funded or directed influencer communications. Carr pressed Van Auken and Smith-Cruz on specifics about the relationship between City Hall and third-party influencers — such as the number of influencers the administration has worked with, how much has been spent on the social media campaigns, how budgets are determined and how influencers are selected. Van Auken and Smith-Cruz acknowledged they didn’t have fulsome answers to any of Carr’s questions, in stark contrast with the mayor’s characterization of the situation earlier today. “I am confident in the testimony that our administration is providing today, that it will be sufficient in answering the council's questions,” Mamdani told reporters this morning. Taiwan Green, a Queens-based influencer with more than 50,000 followers, testified he was contacted a year ago by then-candidate Mamdani’s social media team. He said he’s never been offered pay for any content about the administration, though, and that he was never directed as to how to message his videos. “I believe it’s my responsibility to sacrifice my time and my resources to educate myself and my followers on the political process,” said Green, who goes by the handle @mrfingaz. “Traditional press may not have the time to ask questions that are related to southeast Queens, but I will use this opportunity to do just that.” Green left abruptly after about 90 seconds of testimony and didn’t take questions from council members. It wasn’t the first time relevant officials from the mayor’s office skipped a Council oversight meeting. Last month, lawmakers slammed Mamdani’s administration for opting out of a hearing on the city’s controversial pied-à-terre tax rollout. At that hearing, Council Members Gale Brewer and Linda Lee read out 11 pages of questions to a row of empty chairs. — Molly Reinmann SO MANY GAVELS: The city’s Conflicts of Interest Board fined Council member Mercedes Narcisse $2,500 for filming a reelection campaign video inside City Hall. In one portion of the video, Narcisse is sitting in the Council chambers at the speaker’s chair, where she strikes a gavel. In another, she sits behind her nameplate in a separate committee room and … also strikes a gavel. Narcisse is then filmed speaking (though not striking a gavel) at an official Council podium. Because these areas of City Hall are off limits to the public, the board found Narcisee was using her government perch for personal gain. In a settlement agreement, the Brooklyn lawmaker said she did not intend to break the rules, but admitted wrongdoing. — Joe Anuta FROM THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL AOC IN BUF: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez is planning to hit Buffalo Thursday to meet with Mayor Sean Ryan and host an organizing training aimed at inactive voters. The trip comes amid speculation about whether she’ll run for the White House or Senate in 2028. In comments to The New York Times published on Tuesday, Ocasio-Cortez said she’s thinking about how her identity will factor into the campaign she chooses to mount. “There’s an argument that some make that this is a very unique political window and, oftentimes in politics, you do only get one shot,” she told the Times. “And you don’t — and just in life in general — life doesn’t wait for you to be ready for things. Sometimes life just makes things ready for you.” The Buffalo trip is part of an upstate swing that is also set to include Syracuse and Ithaca, the Times reported last week . Ocasio-Cortez has been leaning into the curiosity surrounding her next political endeavor — but said she’s keeping her focus on the midterms as she stumps across the country boosting candidates. — Madison Fernandez TAKING THE STAGE: Candidates for governor, state attorney general and comptroller will debate next month. Spectrum News NY1 announced Tuesday that Hochul and Blakeman will debate on Oct. 13. Attorney General Letitia James will face off against GOP challenger Saritha Komatireddy on Oct. 8, and Comptroller Tom DiNapoli and Republican Joseph Hernandez will debate on Oct. 1. Each of the debates will air live at 7 p.m. Playbook previously reported that Hochul intended to debate Blakeman, even though she is not required to do so since her campaign declined to participate in the new public campaign finance system. — Madison Fernandez IN OTHER NEWS — ZO + BIBI: Mamdani doubled down on his criticism of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of his speech at the U.N. this week. ( CNN ) — SCHUMER ON AI: Sen. Chuck Schumer demanded Trump completely block China’s access to U.S. artificial intelligence technology ahead of the president’s meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping tomorrow. ( Punchbowl ) — MENIN + THE MET: City Council Speaker Julie Menin expanded on her condemnation of the Met Gala’s now-walked back decision to honor John Galliano, who has a history of racism and antisemitism. ( New York Magazine ) Missed this morning’s New York Playbook? We forgive you. Read it here .

articles.body: <p>Un espray de gas pimienta alteró ayer la sesión parlamentaria en el Congreso. El aerosol no fue introducido por ningún elemento ajeno a las Cortes ni lo lanzó ningún manifestante desde la calle: la diputada del PP, Ana Vázquez Blanco, había comunicado a su grupo el día anterior su decisión <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/armengol-pide-a-la-diputada-popular-ana-vazquez-que-abandone-la-camara-por-sacar-un-bote-de-gas-pimienta.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/armengol-pide-a-la-diputada-popular-ana-vazquez-que-abandone-la-camara-por-sacar-un-bote-de-gas-pimienta.html">de exhibirlo durante la sesión de control al Gobierno</a> para denunciar así la inseguridad en las calles de Ceuta. En principio, dicen fuentes populares, todos pensaron que lo llevaría vacío, pero el gas se propagó por algunos conductos del Congreso. La policía del Cámara baja logró hacerse con el “arma” de la discordia a las 12.45, después de más de tres horas de especulaciones y pesquisas para aclarar por qué el tóxico provocó que 12 personas tuvieran que ser atendidas por los servicios médicos y se precintaran espacios de dos edificios a ambos lados de la carrera de San Jerónimo. “La película que se montan estos socialistas”, se justificaba después de todo en televisión la diputada, que es una habitual tertuliana. Además, es policía de profesión. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-24/una-sesion-del-congreso-incendiada-por-el-gas-pimienta-de-las-bromas-por-el-ataque-hibrido-al-riesgo-de-sanciones-al-pp.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>Las joyas de José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero se le siguen atragantando al PSOE. Las explicaciones del expresidente del Gobierno sobre el origen del ajuar, <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/zapatero-asegura-al-juez-que-las-joyas-son-un-regalo-de-arabia-saudi-de-2007.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/zapatero-asegura-al-juez-que-las-joyas-son-un-regalo-de-arabia-saudi-de-2007.html">un “obsequio” de Arabia Saudí en 2007</a> que guardaba en una caja fuerte en su despacho, han dejado a los socialistas más allá de Ferraz “igual o más” alicaídos de lo que ya estaban por la causa judicial que afecta a uno de sus grandes referentes. Lejos de contentarlos, han contribuido al desconcierto y enojo. “Cuesta digerirlo, porque encima que llegan tarde resulta que [las joyas] fueron el regalo de una monarquía medieval de un país que no respeta los derechos humanos, donde por ejemplo ser homosexual es un delito que se castiga con la muerte. A mí eso no me vale. ¡Cuando nosotros somos los del matrimonio entre personas del mismo sexo o que defiende la igualdad entre hombres y mujeres!“, lamenta un secretario general autonómico.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-24/dirigentes-del-psoe-lamentan-las-contradicciones-de-zapatero-con-las-joyas-donde-queda-la-etica.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Dirigentes del PSOE lamentan las “contradicciones” de Zapatero con las joyas: “¿Dónde queda la ética?”

Lo que sigue son las implicaciones legales y éticas de esas explicaciones enviadas al magistrado de la Audiencia Nacional con el propósito de enterrar la pieza separada sobre las joyas. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-24/el-valor-de-las-joyas-de-zapatero-segun-la-tasacion-pericial-apunta-a-un-delito-fiscal-aunque-haya-prescrito.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: El valor de las joyas de Zapatero según la tasación pericial apunta a un delito fiscal, aunque haya prescrito

articles.body: <p>El mes de diciembre acabó con los círculos económicos y empresariales de Barcelona vestidos de luto. <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2025-12-29/carles-vilarrubi-una-trayectoria-entre-empresa-deporte-e-instituciones.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2025-12-29/carles-vilarrubi-una-trayectoria-entre-empresa-deporte-e-instituciones.html">Carles Vilarrubí</a>, esposo de Sol Daurella, la presidenta de Coca-Cola Europacific Partners, falleció a los 71 años de edad y <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2025-12-30/familia-y-amigos-se-despiden-de-carles-vilarrubi-en-un-funeral-en-barcelona.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2025-12-30/familia-y-amigos-se-despiden-de-carles-vilarrubi-en-un-funeral-en-barcelona.html">su velatorio</a>, el 29 de diciembre, congregó en el tanatorio de Sant Gervasi a todos aquellos que querían despedirse de quien fue, entre otras dedicaciones, directivo del Barça, impulsor de Catalunya Ràdio y chófer de la confianza de <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2026-09-11/jordi-pujol-reaparece-con-un-mensaje-contra-los-extremismos-yo-me-apago-pero-vosotros-teneis-un-futuro-colectivo.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2026-09-11/jordi-pujol-reaparece-con-un-mensaje-contra-los-extremismos-yo-me-apago-pero-vosotros-teneis-un-futuro-colectivo.html">Jordi Pujol</a>. En otra planta del mismo tanatorio, situado en la parte alta de la ciudad, se instaló ese mismo día el velatorio de Josep Juanpere Miret, el arquitecto que diseñó las sedes de varias de las grandes empresas que operan en Cataluña y que, durante años, se especializó en el interiorismo de establecimientos de lujo como el Hotel Arts, el Grand Marina, el The Mirror, el Hesperia Tower, todos ellos en Barcelona, el Kimpton Los Monteros, en Marbella, o los exclusivos apartamentos de Alcántara 25, en Madrid. Juanpere había fallecido súbitamente en su apartamento de Baqueira (Vall d’Aran) por lo que parecieron causas naturales. Este miércoles trascendió la detención de su mujer por, supuestamente, haber causado la muerte de forma intencionada. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2026-09-24/giro-de-guion-en-la-muerte-en-baqueira-del-arquitecto-de-la-burguesia-catalana.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/T3WJ5SWVWND25IJNCCMMSOI2VI.jpg?auth=551f8eccc7b4afa4973d6c18ee946c9d8bc3dccdba31ba6e3e18cb115e6e946a" width="3704" height="2435" alt="Begoña Gómez en una comisión en la Asamblea de Madrid, en noviembre de 2024."></img><p>Hay días en que las decisiones judiciales nos recuerdan algunos ejercicios de prestidigitación. Nada por aquí, nada por allá, pero resulta que había —o alguien ha creído ver— un elefante en la habitación. O al revés. Allá donde parecía existir una grave responsabilidad por inacción o falta de diligencia frente a una catástrofe natural, por ejemplo, solo hay el fondo vacío de una chistera. En algún momento se recuperarán la calma y los esquemas clásicos en la distribución del poder, también con respecto a las salas de justicia, pero por ahora es desde ellas desde donde emergen decisiones que marcan la vida política del país. A veces, para desconcierto y perplejidad general. El papel de los tribunales en el control de las decisiones del ejecutivo y el legislativo ha adquirido tanta relevancia que no faltará quien proponga que se deje de utilizar la expresión poder judicial para empezar a hablar de la justicia como “contrapoder de Estado”.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-24/la-justicia-como-contrapoder-de-estado.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: La justicia como “contrapoder de Estado”

articles.body: <p>¿Vuelve <a href="https://elpais.com/noticias/ada-colau-ballano/" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/noticias/ada-colau-ballano/">Ada Colau</a> al tablero político? “Parece que sí, Ada no da puntada sin hilo, pero también puede ser un globo sonda”, “Con Ada, ¿quién sabe?“, ”Se está preparando”. Las respuestas son de tres personas próximas a la exalcaldesa de Barcelona. Tras mantener perfil bajo desde que <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2024-10-25/ada-colau-en-su-despedida-del-ayuntamiento-de-barcelona-lo-que-mas-me-ha-decepcionado-de-la-ciudad-son-las-elites-provincianas-mediocres-y-avariciosas.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2024-10-25/ada-colau-en-su-despedida-del-ayuntamiento-de-barcelona-lo-que-mas-me-ha-decepcionado-de-la-ciudad-son-las-elites-provincianas-mediocres-y-avariciosas.html">se marchó del Ayuntamiento de Barcelona hace dos años</a> la líder de los comunes y actual presidenta de su fundación (Sentit Comú) ha reaparecido con intensidad en la última semana: es tertuliana en el matinal en catalán de RTVE, dio entrevista a <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2026-09-17/ada-colau-a-marc-giro-me-hierve-la-sangre-al-ver-a-estos-pijos-recortando-dinero-publico-y-gastandolo-en-un-atico.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2026-09-17/ada-colau-a-marc-giro-me-hierve-la-sangre-al-ver-a-estos-pijos-recortando-dinero-publico-y-gastandolo-en-un-atico.html">Marc Giró</a> en La Sexta, participó en la manifestación contra la ampliación del aeropuerto el domingo en Barcelona y el lunes <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2026-09-21/colau-participa-en-una-concentracion-contra-un-desahucio-en-el-barrio-de-gracia-de-barcelona.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2026-09-21/colau-participa-en-una-concentracion-contra-un-desahucio-en-el-barrio-de-gracia-de-barcelona.html">se sumó a los activistas</a> que intentaban parar un desahucio en su barrio. “Ada Colau vuelve a la primera línea de la lucha por la vivienda para intentar frenar el desahucio de una vecina de Gràcia”, tituló abriendo el lunes <i>La Futura Info</i>, un portal de noticias vinculado a la fundación del partido en el que no aparecen firmados los textos ni las fotos. La exalcaldesa también ha vuelto a escribir a un canal de Telegram que llevaba meses en silencio. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2026-09-24/ada-colau-se-asoma-de-nuevo-a-la-politica.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero ha aclarado este miércoles el origen de <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-06-11/la-tasacion-de-las-joyas-incautadas-a-zapatero-cifra-su-valor-en-unos-13-millones-de-euros.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-06-11/la-tasacion-de-las-joyas-incautadas-a-zapatero-cifra-su-valor-en-unos-13-millones-de-euros.html">las joyas que la Policía le incautó</a>: asegura que son un “obsequio” personal que Arabia Saudí le hizo en 2007 cuando estaba en La Moncloa. El expresidente del Gobierno, en un escrito dirigido al juez, que le mantiene investigado en el <i>caso Plus Ultra</i>, y que ha avanzado EL PAÍS, sostiene que una docena de piezas valiosas halladas durante el registro en su despacho el pasado mes de mayo son <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/estas-son-las-12-joyas-que-zapatero-senala-como-un-regalo-del-rey-saudi-en-2007.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/estas-son-las-12-joyas-que-zapatero-senala-como-un-regalo-del-rey-saudi-en-2007.html">un regalo del monarca saudí Abdulá Bin Abdulaziz Al-Saud (fallecido en 2015)</a>. Pide a la Audiencia Nacional que solicite la cooperación del país para acreditar su relato.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/zapatero-asegura-al-juez-que-las-joyas-son-un-regalo-de-arabia-saudi-de-2007.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p><h3>Calama envía a prisión provisional al financiero neerlandés clave en el ‘caso Plus Ultra’</h3><p>En el marco de esta investigación, el juez ha acordado enviar a prisión provisional al banquero neerlandés Simon Leendert Verhoeven, detenido el martes por las autoridades alemanas, "una vez se materialice su entrega". Este empresario es una de las piezas clave del presunto blanqueo de fondos con supuestos fondos ilícitos procedentes de Venezuela en el caso Plus Ultra. En una resolución a la que también ha tenido acceso este periódico, Calama ha asegurado que le tomará declaración el viernes, a las 9.00, en la sede de la Audiencia Nacional.</p>
articles.headline: Zapatero asegura al juez que las joyas son un “obsequio” que el rey de Arabia Saudí le hizo en 2007

articles.body: <p>El drama del desahucio de Maricarmen, de 87 años, ha generado una gran conmoción especialmente entre sectores progresistas, que apuntan al Gobierno de Pedro Sánchez por no haber sido capaz de frenarlo. Preguntado por este asunto en Nueva York, en la habitual rueda de prensa durante la cumbre de la ONU en Nueva York, Sánchez ha responsabilizado directamente a la Comunidad de Madrid y el Ayuntamiento de Madrid, en manos del PP, contra los que ha cargado de forma dura porque cree que podían haber impedido el desahucio o buscar una solución alternativa y no han hecho nada. “El desahucio de Maricarmen es una tragedia social que no podemos aceptar como país”, ha arrancado el presidente, que llevaba preparado un largo discurso sobre este asunto que genera mucha tensión especialmente a sus potenciales votantes. “Hay que decir que hay dos administraciones competentes en la protección de personas vulnerables como Maricarmen, el Ayuntamiento de Madrid y la Comunidad de Madrid, que están mas preocupados en comprar aticazos de 200 metros de terraza pero han hecho caso omiso a una tragedia social que debería ser resuelta”.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/pedro-sanchez-comparece-antes-de-su-discurso-en-naciones-unidas.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Sánchez carga contra Ayuso y Almeida por la “tragedia social” del desahucio de Maricarmen: “Están más preocupados en comprar aticazos”

articles.body: <p>La defensa del expresidente José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero ha argumentado ante el juez que lo investiga que <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/zapatero-asegura-al-juez-que-las-joyas-son-un-regalo-de-arabia-saudi-de-2007.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/zapatero-asegura-al-juez-que-las-joyas-son-un-regalo-de-arabia-saudi-de-2007.html">12 de las más de 60 joyas encontradas en la caja fuerte de su despacho —las más valiosas— fueron un regalo</a>, con ocasión de una visita oficial en 2007, del por entonces rey de Arabia Saudí Abdullah Bin Abdulaziz Al-Saud. La docena de joyas señalada por Zapatero constituye un lote que la casa de subastas Ansorena valoró en más de 1.233.000 euros. O, lo que es lo mismo, el 93,2% del valor de todas las piezas incautadas en el registro de su despacho. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/estas-son-las-12-joyas-que-zapatero-senala-como-un-regalo-del-rey-saudi-en-2007.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>La polémica del bote de gas pimienta que ha opacado el debate parlamentario sobre la situación de Ceuta este miércoles comenzó a primera hora, cuando la diputada del PP Ana Vázquez exhibió el espray en el Congreso, que ha calificado de ser “material escolar básico” de los escolares ceutíes. Tras dos llamadas al orden a Vázquez de la presidenta de la Cámara por mostrar el aerosol, Francina Armengol ha terminado por expulsarla. Pero el rocambolesco episodio ha continuado luego: la policía ha tenido que acordonar varios baños y zonas aledañas del edificio de las Cortes porque alguien había accionado el vaporizador y 12 personas han sufrido las consecuencias de inhalar el gas irritante. Finalmente, un trabajador del PP ha admitido haber sido él el que ha pulsado “sin querer” la boquilla del bote, que le había pasado la diputada, a pesar de que esta había asegurado antes que estaba vacío.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/armengol-pide-a-la-diputada-popular-ana-vazquez-que-abandone-la-camara-por-sacar-un-bote-de-gas-pimienta.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>A un lado de la frontera, en aguas de Marruecos, tres pequeñas lanchas con varios gendarmes a bordo y un barco mediano de color gris de las Fuerzas marroquíes daban vueltas a última hora de la tarde de este miércoles. articles.body: Vols veure els focs artificials de la Mercè 2026 a la platja? Aquest any hi haurà dues nits en què ho podràs fer, en el marc del XXVII Festival Pirotècnic Internacional . Els focs es llançaran a tocar de l’ espigó del Gas , però es podran veure, i gaudir, des de diferents punts del litoral, on es podran seguir els espectacles de llum, color i so. Tot seguit t’expliquem quins dies, els horaris i els millors llocs des d’on veure bé els focs artificials de la Mercè 2026 . I recorda que, a banda d’aquestes dues jornades a la platja (on el 24 de setembre hi haurà una nit de drons ), us heu d’apuntar a l’agenda el gran espectacle de focs, el Piromusical de la Mercè (27 de setembre), també a la platja, però la de la Nova Icària. >> Mercè 2026: guia completa On veure els focs artificials del Festival Pirotècnic de Barcelona? Les millors ubicacions per veure els focs artificials són just a tocar de l’espigó del Gas . Per exemple, hi ha l’opció de seguir l’espectacle des del mateix passeig Marítim de la Barceloneta – Oriol Bohigas , si bé la sorra és un dels llocs preferits per la gran majoria de ciutadans per gaudir-lo. Així, tant la platja del Somorrostro com la de la Barceloneta solen ser punts de molta afluència, ja que són a tocar de l’espigó. Ara bé, altres punts del litoral, com la platja de Sant Miquel i la de Sant Sebastià , també són bones opcions per veure l’evolució de la pirotècnia. Focs artificials de la Mercè 2026 Divendres 25 de setembre El divendres 25 de setembre , l’endemà de la Mercè, es farà el primer dia d’espectacle del Festival Pirotècnic Internacional. La primera actuació omplirà de llum i color el cel barceloní de 22 a 22.20 h i anirà a càrrec de Pirotècnia FWF Concept , amb 40 anys d’experiència i vinguda des de França. (i recordeu que el dijous 24 de setembre en aquest mateix escenari, nit de drons !) Hi ha diverses opcions per desplaçar-se fins a la zona de l’espigó del Gas amb  transport públic . articles.body: Quina exposició de Barcelona vols visitar? Aquesta és l’ agenda d’exposicions a Barcelona per al 2026.  Entra-hi i tria! Hi trobaràs exposicions de fotografia, pintura, art i molt més! Algunes de les propostes culturals són gratuïtes. Si no tens clar quin museu de Barcelona vols visitar , potser aquí et podem ajudar! A més, recorda que hi ha molts museus de Barcelona que es poden visitar gratuïtament cada primer diumenge de mes ! Vols rebre més plans com aquests abans que ningú? Cada divendres, a la teva bústia, la millor selecció de propostes (moltes de gratuïtes!) per al cap de setmana. Subscriu‑te al butlletí ‘Què fer a Barcelona’ “El culte a la bellesa” La mostra examina com ha evolucionat el concepte de bellesa al llarg de la història i explora les dimensions filosòfiques, culturals, artístiques i científiques que l’envolten. Es poden veure obres de William Hogarth, Angelica Dass, Laura Aguilar, Juno Calypso, Zed Nelson, Shirin Fathi, Narcissister, Ismael Smith, Isidre Nonell, Josep Masana, Colita, Sandra Gamarra, Esther Ferrer, Regina José Galindo, Maria Alcaide o Harriet Davey. Al CCCB, del 21 de maig al 8 de novembre de 2026. “Presoners de l’amor. Fins al sol de la llibertat” (últims dies) La resiliència del poble palestí centra l’ exposició de Basel Abbas i Ruanne Abou-Rahme al MACBA . Els artistes palestins presenten una videoinstal·lació immersiva de caràcter poètic amb què recullen testimonis d’antics presoners palestins. Fins al 28 de setembre del 2026. El cartell de la Mercè, en un mural a la Biblioteca Candel La terrassa interior de la Biblioteca la Marina de Port – Francesc Candel té un espai expositiu amb dos grans murals a banda i banda. Es pot visitar el mural del cartell de la Mercè 2026 , de 33 m², i també el mural ‘Natura naturae’. “Restaurats” Els Gegants Centenaris de Sant Roc de la Plaça Nova, el Roc i la Laieta, han estat sotmesos a un gran procés de restauració. A l’exposició s’hi poden veure els treballs complexos per restaurar i restituir les escultures, les policromies i la confecció dels vestits, joies i complements. Fins al 8 de novembre, a La Casa dels Entremesos. “Del trencadís al pinzell. 100 anys del naixement d’Antoni Gaudí” (últims dies) L’artista Josep Maria Bertran reinterpreta l’univers arquitectònic de Gaudí a través de la pintura a l’oli. Del 14 al 27 de setembre, als Quatre Gats (carrer de Montsió, 3). “Barcelona Iniesta Experience: El Joc Interior” Exposició immersiva que proposa un recorregut per la trajectòria esportiva i personal de l’exjugador del Barça d’Andrés Iniesta. L’exposició combina tecnologia, continguts audiovisuals i elements interactius. A partir del 28 de setembre i fins al 10 de gener de 2027. l’Imax, Port Vell. Museu Picasso: gratuït de dijous a dissabte al vespre Sabies que hi ha diverses opcions per visitar gratuïtament el Museu Picasso? El primer diumenge de mes, en dates especials determinades, i dijous, divendres i dissabte al vespre! >>   Aquí t’ho expliquem “Un teatre lliure” Exposició sobre el Teatre Lliure que es fixa en la figura de l’escenògraf i en la idea de l’espai. Hi ha cinc instal·lacions creades pels escenògrafs Frederic Amat , Montse Amenós , Max Glaenzel , Lluc Castells i Sílvia Delagnau , que han contribuït a construir l’imaginari visual del teatre. Del 21 de setembre al 17 de gener de 2027. Al Palau Robert “Dalí Boulevard Cibernètic” Experiència immersiva d’arts digitals que explora l’obra de Salvador Dalí a través del seu pensament futurista i la seva relació amb la ciència, la pintura, l’escultura, el disseny o la moda. A partir del 15 de setembre. A la Casa Amatller. Exposició permanent. “Codi Gaudí. L’experiència inèdita” Exposició immersiva que porta el visitant a descobrir en primera persona les tècniques, les formes i la lògica que connecten tota l’obra de Gaudí. Es podran visitar els edificis que va imaginar Gaudí. Del 22 de setembre del 2026 fins al gener del 2027, a l’Espai Imagina. “Pòsters Magistrals de La Rambla” L’exposició recull les propostes de 10 artistes amb discapacitat intel·lectual. La mostra és fruit d’un encàrrec professional d’Amics de La Rambla a la Fundació Setba, en el marc de la campanya Pòster de La Rambla, per crear un nou pòster turístic inspirat en la renovada Rambla de Santa Mònica. Del 21 de setembre fins al 25 d’octubre, de 8.30 a 14.30 h. Al Mirador de Colom . Gratuït . “Trames. Obres tradicionals i creacions contemporànies americanes” L’exposició compta amb la participació de sis artistes contemporanis que s’expressen mitjançant diferents formes i llenguatges creatius, com la pintura, la fotografia, la instal·lació o la videoperformance. Així, les obres de Seba Calfuqueo , Sara Flores , Sheroanawe Hakihiiwe i Bernardo Oyarzún i les fotografies de David Díaz Gonzales i Guadalupe Miles es presenten a l’espai expositiu en diàleg amb les peces de les col·leccions del museu, especialment obres shipibo-konibo i tèxtils precolonials i recents. Del 18 de setembre al 25 d’abril del 2027. Museu Etnològic i de Cultures del Món (seu del carrer Montcada 12). Arquitectura | Oficis L’exposició explora la relació entre arquitectura i ofici a través de peces creades per grans estudis en col·laboració amb artesans. Dins de la Capital Mundial de l’Arquitectura. Galeria ÚNICO ICÓNICO & CO . Carrer de Pallars, 85. Fins a finals de 2026. Gratuït. “Desenfocat. Una altra visió de l’art” (últims dies) El CaixaForum acull la mostra “Desenfocat. Una altra visió de l’art” , que explora el fenomen del desenfocament com a estratègia artística. Es revisen treballs de més de 50 autors com Claude Monet, Mark Rothko, Nan Goldin o Bill Violaels. Al CaixaForum, fins al 27 de setembre. “Antoni Tàpies. El moviment perpetu del mur” (últims dies) L’exposició explora l’obra de l’artista a partir dels seus contextos i modalitats d’exhibició. El projecte s’endinsa en la dècada del 1950, amb la intenció d’oferir perspectives sobre un moment de transformació important en la pràctica de l’artista. Al Museu Tàpies, fins al 27 de setembre moment en què tancarà el museu durant tres mesos. “La fraternitat de les metàfores – Jean-Luc Godard” Gran exposició del cineasta Jean-Luc Godard , un dels pares de la Nouvelle Vague. Hi haurà una extensa mostra del seu cinema, també materials inèdits, quaderns de treball, fotografies personals i projectes irrealitzats. La Virreina Centre de la Imatge , fins al 4 d’octubre. “Gaudí-Miró-Gomis: Deconstructed” Exposició que fa una lectura de les connexions entre Antoni Gaudí, Joan Miró i Joaquim Gomis a través d’instal·lacions que combinen noves tecnologies com la fotogrametria i la intel·ligència artificial generativa amb obres originals de Miró i fotografies de Gomis. Fins al 10 de gener de 2027, a la Casa Batlló. “Gaudí: finestres al futur” El  Palau Güell  acull l’exposició “ Gaudí: finestres al futur ” en el marc de celebració del centenari de la mort d’Antoni Gaudí. La mostra es pot visitar a les golfes de l’edifici. Els visitants poden descobrir guarniments de finestres reals i vitralls que s’utilitzaven en els edificis, rèpliques interactives de finestres i manetes que es poden trobar en aquestes construccions.  Fins al 25 d’octubre . “Dana Lixenberg – American Images” i KBR Flama’26 El Centre de Fotografia KBr de Barcelona obrirà la temporada 2026-27 amb dues exposicions. Una és “Dana Lixenberg – American Images” amb una selecció de l’obra de la fotògrafa neerlandesa sobre realitats diverses de la societat nord-americana. I la segona mostra serà la de “KBR Flama’26”, que és la sisena edició del projecte que dona visibilitat a nous talents de la fotografia formats a Barcelona, amb Sara Bravo, Elena Bulet i Llopis, Lucca Gaetano Pira i Meghan Mathews.  A partir de l ‘1 d’octubre del 2026 . “Barcelona: aigua, clima i ciutat” Mostra permanent que exhibirà una part molt significativa de la Col·lecció Ròmul Gavarró. A la Casa de l’Aigua de Trinitat Nova. Exposició permanent. “L’assalt de la il·lusió” (últims dies) L’exposició  “L’assalt de la il·lusió” proposa un recorregut a través de l’art per les imatges que han construït el desig   i el sentit de realitat en el nostre imaginari. A la mostra hi ha una vintena de projectes d’artistes locals i internacionals que ens endinsen en els mecanismes utilitzats per generar imatges i en el món d’il·lusions, enganys i poder que les envolten . Fins al 27 de setembre. Centre d’art Santa Mònica. Museu Picasso: com visitar-lo gratuïtament El Museu Picasso és una de les vistes imperdibles a la nostra ciutat, a més, hi ha algunes opcions per poder accedir-hi gratuïtament. Aquí t’ho expliquem. “Una col·lecció permanentment canviant” L’ exposició ofereix una nova mirada a 224 obres de 130 artistes i obre un espai sobre l’empresari i mecenes barceloní, Antoni Vila Casas. Museu de Can Framis . Exposició permanent. Museus gratis a Barcelona el primer diumenge de mes: tota la llista Saps que hi ha diversos museus de Barcelona que obren de forma gratuïta cada primer diumenge de mes? Aquí pots consultar quins equipaments són gratuïts. Vestits i accessoris dels segles XIX i XX Victoria Museum El Victoria Museum és un museu nou situat al Raval amb una àmplia proposta de vestits i accessoris dels segles XIX i XX. El projecte, sota la direcció de la col·leccionista Victoria Lysenko, recull tota mena de peces d’indumentària a través de les quals “donar vida a la història”. “Catalunya: Patrimoni Viu” Recorregut immersiu pel patrimoni cultural català emprant hologrames, jocs interactius i realitat virtual. Tracen aquesta panoràmica personatges singulars, monuments emblemàtics, tradicions i celebracions populars. Al Palau Moja (Espai Moja). Gratuït. “Museu” de retroinformàtica Col·lecció d’antiguitats informàtiques al soterrani de la Facultat d’Informàtica de Barcelona (FIB), al Campus Nord de la UPC. L’ exposició és permanent i conté 200 aparells , des de calculadores mecàniques, passant pels primers ordinadors de sobretaula fins a les beceroles del món del videojoc, amb noms mítics de la marca Atari. Al soterrani de la Facultat d’Informàtica de Barcelona. Gratuït. La Sala Univers El Cosmocaixa té una nova exposició permanent. La Sala Univers està formada per tres seccions que porten de l’origen a l’actualitat: Kósmos, sobre l’origen de la matèria i les lleis fonamentals de la naturalesa; Evolució, sobre la creació de la vida; i Fronteres, que mostra els avenços científics del segle XXI. Sala de les Diversions El Museu Frederic Marès ha recuperat la Sala de les Diversions situada a la tercera planta de l’edifici: la Sala de les Diversions, un referent del món de l’oci i la diversió de la societat barcelonina del segle XIX i XX. El MNAC, referent museístic de la Guerra Civil El Museu Nacional d’Art de Catalunya ha ampliat l’exposició permanent dedicada a la Guerra Civil. S’hi poden veure un centenar de peces noves i moltes inèdites. Museu de la Cera El Museu de la Cera és un equipament que s’ha renovat en els últims anys. Ara és interactiu, incorpora escenografies canviants i permet una visita més dinàmica. Museu del Cafè El Museu del Cafè (via Laietana, 36) reuneix més de 2.000 peces i 1.200 volums sobre la cultura del cafè. Hi pots veure molinets de cafè, cafeteres, cartells, utensilis i pots de llautó . La cafetera de ‘Friends’ o el molinet més gran del món són algunes de les peces destacades que es poden veure.

L’Esbord i l’Orquestra de Músiques d’Arrel de Catalunya presenten a la Mercè un espectacle singular que reivindica la riquesa de la música i la dansa tradicionals catalanes, amb set esbarts de la ciutat. Bivouac.  Una estructura escultòrica de gran format es transforma en l’escenari d’un joc constant d’equilibris i desequilibris amb sis acròbates al Parc del Fòrum. Shanghai Acrobatic Troupe.  Una gran gala d’acrobàcia xinesa amb números col·lectius, tècnica de precisió i una posada en escena poc habitual en els festivals de carrer de Barcelona. Cinquanta anys de circ contemporani català. L’Arxiu Viu de Circ i Queralt Suau Studio convertiran la memòria del sector en una intervenció escenogràfica que vestirà els escenaris del Fòrum. Shanghai Rhythms in Dance i Entre arrels.  Dues aproximacions complementàries a la ciutat convidada a l’Estació del Nord: la formació de joves intèrprets i una coproducció híbrida creada a Barcelona. Ignició360  – Núria Andorrà, Suso33 i Roc Mateu.  Grafits en directe, percussió, sons enregistrats al barri i un paisatge immersiu culminen en una acció de gran potència visual al Parc de la Trinitat. A-Run Crew i instal·lació Barcelona-Shanghai.  Les danses urbanes d’una companyia coreana i un projecte de disseny vinculat a la diàspora asiàtica connecten la Trinitat amb altres imaginaris urbans asiàtics. Fleurir les abîmes  – Claire Ducreux.  La creadora presenta a Barcelona una peça visual i de dansa als Jardins de Joan Maragall – Palauet Albéniz. Serena  – Circ Bover.  Circ i música en directe a partir d’un vaixell de vela llatina al Port Olímpic: memòria marítima i metàfora de la fragilitat i la resistència de la cultura catalana. El Mercè Arts de Carrer s’estrena a Glòries .  Un nou parc de la ciutat acull una jornada contínua de circ, música, teatre, dansa, itineràncies i joc en diàleg amb la biodiversitat i el brogit urbà el 24 de setembre. articles.body: L’ espectacle de drons El fil vermell. De Barcelona a Shanghai és un dels plats forts d’aquesta Mercè 2026. 750 drons s’enlairaran en una exhibició que ha generat ja molta expectació i amb uns creadors de solvència contrastada, Flock Drone Art Studio , que també van ser al darrere del celebrat espectacle inaugural de la torre de Jesús de la Sagrada Família. El seu CEO, Fran Arnau, ha donat detalls del xou al programa Bàsics , en què ha abordat les infinites possibilitats d’aquesta tecnologia per crear espectacles cada cop més sofisticats i espectaculars. També et pot interessar Drons de la Mercè 2026: data, horari i on veure l’espectacle aeri de llums i música Eva Vial Sílvia Carbonell 3 minuts de lectura Animació 3D i GPS Flock Drone ja va ser responsable d’un espectacle de drons a la platja del Somorrostro el 2022. En aquell moment van comptar amb un centenar de dispositius. Ara es multiplica per set el nombre d’aparells que recorreran el cel de Barcelona en un espectacle que vol enllaçar elements culturals de les dues ciutats: Barcelona i Shanghai , la ciutat convidada aquest any. El xou s’inspira en la llegenda oriental del fil vermell del destí. Es podrà veure el 24 de setembre , dia de la Mercè, a   l ’ Espigó del Gas de la Barceloneta en dues sessions, a les 21 h i a les 22 h . L’èxit de la Sagrada Família El CEO de la companyia, Fran Arnau ha destacat al Bàsics que hi ha “nervis i ganes” de veure com es plasmen mesos de treball. Més d’una vintena de persones han treballat en un espectacle dissenyat al mil·límetre per una plantilla d’una vintena de persones — dibuixants, animadors 3D i també tot un equip tècnic— que ha sincronitzat tots els moviments dels drons, coordinats amb GPS sobre el terreny. Apassionat d’aquesta tecnologia, Arnau subratlla que no pararà de créixer, amb espectacles cada cop més complexos tècnicament i amb més espectacularitat. Creix també la magnitud i aquesta companyia acaba d’enlairar més de 3.000 drons en un xou a Portugal. Els pirodrons amenacen els focs artificials? En aquesta exhibició barcelonina no es veuran encara pirodrons —drons que permeten llançar també focs artificials— i que la companyia ja ha desplegat en diverses ocasions. Fran Arnau destaca el potencial d’aquesta tecnologia que combina llums làser i pirotècnia: “Són dues formes d’art que han de poder conviure”, explica Arnau. Creu que els drons no poden competir amb “l’olor de pólvora”, però apunta que són més nets i no deixen residus i permeten esbossar al cel figures precises en moviment . Quan li han preguntat sobre l’emotiu espectacle de la Sagrada Família, del qual també en són responsables, Arnau destaca que va ser molt emocionant i que no eren conscients de la repercussió mundial que tindria, després de més d’un any de feina intensa de preparació. articles.body: El dissabte 26 de setembre es viuran emocions intenses a la platja del Bogatell, en el marc de les Festes de la Mercè 2026 . Si us agrada la festa, no us podeu perdre un dels concerts gratuïts més esperats del programa, que reunirà tres noms destacats de l’escena catalana: Love of Lesbian, La Pegatina i Svetlana . I atenció! Si no pots anar-hi, a betevé oferirem en directe els concerts . Es podrà seguir, dissabte 26 de setembre, a partir de les 21 h a la TDT, el web i l’app de betevé, el canal 166 de Movistar+ i La Xarxa+. El grup d’indie rock i indie pop va anunciar a principis d’any que farà una “pausa indefinida” després de 25 anys de trajectòria d’èxit, i el concert gratuït al Bogatell és una bona oportunitat per gaudir d’un dels directes més vibrants de l’escena espanyola, en què repassarà els temes del darrer disc, Ejercito de salvación , però on segur que sonaran altres temes, alguns dels quans són veritables himnes per als seus fans.
